items.summary: September is Emergency Preparedness Month, and the North Attleborough Fire Department is encouraging residents to take steps to ensure they and their families are prepared for emergencies.

items.title: Falls Pond and Whitings Pond Scheduled for Algae Treatment Sept. 3
items.summary: The Town of North Attleborough is notifying residents that Falls Pond and Whitings Pond are scheduled to be chemically treated for the control of algae on Thursday, Sept. 3, 2026.

items.title: North Attleborough Fire Department Responds to Multiple Incidents
items.summary: The North Attleborough Fire Department responded to multiple incidents Monday morning, including a deck fire at the Ledges Condominiums and a motor vehicle crash, with assistance from neighboring fire departments.

items.title: September Hours: Building & Health Departments
items.summary: There is a change in the Building and Health Department office hours, starting Tuesday, September 1st.

items.title: North Attleborough Firefighter/EMT John Cooper Retires After 36 Years of Service
items.summary: The Town of North Attleborough and North Attleborough Fire Department are recognizing Firefighter/EMT John “Coop” Cooper as he retires following 36 years of dedicated service to the department and the community.

items.title: Fall Hydrant Flushing is Underway
items.summary: Fall hydrant flushing will be underway through October 2026.

items.title: Silent Book Club meets at 6pm on the first Thursday of the month at North Branch Library.
items.summary: We’re excited to announce that Silent Book Club is coming to the North Branch Library! Our September meeting will take place on Thursday, Sept. 3rd, from 6:00–7:30 p.m. The group will continue meeting monthly at 6pm on the first Thursday of each month.

items.title: SMART Billing Abatement Deadline
items.summary: Please be advised that the last day to submit an abatement request for SMART Billing is Sept. 30, 2026. All abatement requests must be received by the DPW no later than Sept. 30th to be considered. For questions, please call the DPW 508-999-0740.

items.title: Child Hospitalized After Being Hit By Car In Attleboro: Report
items.summary: An Attleboro collision between the car and bicycle is now is now under investigation.

items.title: Swansea Police Department and Swansea Public Schools Assign New School Resource Officers
items.summary: Chief Mark Foley and Superintendent Scott C. Holcomb are pleased to introduce Swansea Public Schools' two new School Resource Officers.
